assumptions.choice: ordered = min(EMA8, EMA13, EMA21) > max(EMA34, EMA55), i.e. the whole fast group above the whole slow group, not a strict five-way fan-out (EMA8>EMA13>EMA21>EMA34>EMA55)
assumptions.reason: the spec's own parenthetical defines ordering as '(fast above slow)', not a full monotonic ribbon ordering

assumptions.choice: treat entry/exit as the transition of the boolean 'fast group above slow group' state (False->True triggers entry, True->False triggers exit), rather than requiring six separate pairwise fast-vs-slow crossovers to align on one bar
assumptions.reason: the spec bundles 'cross' and 'form an ordered sequence' into one combined event; the ordered-state transition is the most literal single-condition reading of 'cross ... and form an ordered sequence'

assumptions.choice: place native backtrader Stop and Limit sell orders (OCO) immediately after the entry fill, at fixed 2%/4% distance from the executed entry price; both are canceled if the ribbon-reversal exit fires first
assumptions.reason: the spec states fixed price-level stop-loss/take-profit; native Stop/Limit orders give exact price-triggered execution rather than only checking bar-close prices

assumptions.choice: use self.broker.getvalue() (total portfolio value) at signal time as 'total trading capital', size = 2% of that value divided by the current close price
assumptions.reason: spec says '2% of total trading capital' without specifying cash vs equity; since entries only occur while flat, portfolio value equals available cash at that moment so the choice is not material to results

assumptions.choice: size is computed using the signal bar's close price as an entry-price estimate; the actual fill occurs at the next bar's open under the harness's default order timing
assumptions.reason: the exact fill price is unknown at the moment size must be computed, so the most recent close is used as the literal reading of the trade's reference price
